title: Indirect inference in incomplete and partially identified econometric models
abstract: arXiv:2610.36206v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We extend the indirect inference principle to structural econometric models that are incomplete, in the sense that a single value of the structural parameter may be compatible with multiple distributions of the observed endogenous variables, so that the structural parameter is typically only partially identified. We define the binding function as the smallest norm of the auxiliary estimating equations over the set of data generating processes compatible with the structural model. Hence, we obtain a confidence region by inverting a test of the hypothesis that the binding function vanishes at the pseudo-true value. A dual characterization based on random set theory makes the binding function computationally tractable. translated_title: 不完全且部分识别计量经济模型中的间接推断
translated_abstract: 我们将间接推断原理扩展到不完全的结构计量经济模型，即单个结构参数值可能与多个可观测内生变量分布相容，因此结构参数通常只能被部分识别。我们将绑定函数定义为辅助估计方程在与结构模型相容的数据生成过程集合上的最小范数。由此，我们通过反转“绑定函数在伪真值处为零”这一假设的检验来获得置信区域。基于随机集理论的对偶刻画使绑定函数在计算上可行。我们将辅助模型以协变量为条件进行定义，以消除其对未知协变量分布的依赖，并证明绑定函数是Lipschitz的且具有Hadamard方向可微性，因此……
tldr: 该论文将间接推断方法扩展到不完全且参数仅部分识别的结构计量模型，通过将绑定函数定义为辅助估计方程在相容数据生成过程集合上的最小范数，并借助随机集理论的对偶刻画使其可计算，从而构建出参数的置信区域。
en_tdlr: This paper extends indirect inference to incomplete and partially identified structural econometric models by defining the binding function as the minimal norm of auxiliary estimating equations over the set of compatible data generating processes, making it computationally tractable via random set theory duality to construct confidence regions.
